headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.3
summary: CurseForge content details now have a Gallery tab next to Description: screenshots load in a compact grid, tap to view fullscreen, and GIF screenshots animate. Mods without screenshots simply keep the Description tab.

items.text: CurseForge content details now have a Gallery tab with a 3-column screenshot grid next to Description.
Tap a screenshot to open it fullscreen; animated GIF screenshots play right in the viewer.
Mods without screenshots keep the Description tab instead of showing an empty Gallery.
